name: Wagon at Work
jem_summary: Hitch a horse to a wagon, transport one mob passenger and unload it safely.

pages.title: Wagon at Work
pages.text: Hitch a horse to a wagon, transport one mob passenger and unload it safely.

pages.title: Wagon at Work
pages.text: A whip, wheels and fodder supply more real transport without granting a finished second wagon.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Leash the horse and sneak-interact with the wagon. Load an eligible mob at a stationary wagon, move it and unload. The whip adjusts speed; off-seat sneak interaction changes direction.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Leash a horse, then crouch-interact with the wagon. Attach the horse to pull the wagon.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the Horse Whip while driving to change speed; crouch-interact off-seat to switch direction. Drive or reverse the wagon.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Crouch-interact with a leashed mob at the wagon or a mob beside a stationary wagon. Seat a mob for transport; crouch interaction also supports unloading.
